items.title: 黃仁勳揭輝達管理哲學是「台灣父母式教育」、希望「在工作崗位上離世」
items.title_en: Jensen Huang Describes Nvidia's Management Philosophy as "Taiwanese Parental Style" and Hopes to "Die at His Desk"
paras: 輝達(NVDA-US) 執行長黃仁勳近日罕見談及自己的管理哲學。他坦言，自己幾乎會批評員工交出的每一項成果，並將這種嚴格的管理方式形容為「台灣父母式」的管教。黃仁勳強調，這種做法並非為了懲罰員工，而是希望第一時間指出問題，讓對方有機會把事情做得更好。從在職員工到離職創業者，他都維持同樣直接的回饋方式。
黃仁勳接受《CAN》專訪時表示，在台灣父母的觀念中，很難出現「已經夠好了」的時刻，因此他也幾乎不會讓員工拿著成果來找他、卻完全沒有被挑出問題。
黃仁勳1963年出生於台北，童年時搬到台南，父親是一名煉油廠化學工程師。他過去多次談及台灣父母的教養方式，認為父母總是希望子女能夠做得更好，即使到了現在，他仍會持續從父親那裡得到建議。
不過，黃仁勳認為，嚴格批評的核心其實是愛與信任。他表示，提出回饋後，自己會立即回到關心對方的狀態，讓員工知道批評針對的是工作本身，而不是個人。
他的管理方式也強調「即時回饋」。一旦發現問題，就在當下提出，而不是把意見累積到日後才一次處理，藉此避免小問題進一步擴大。

高壓管理下　輝達員工離職率僅2.5%

值得注意的是，黃仁勳的管理方式看似高壓，但輝達員工的留任表現卻相當突出。
根據輝達最新永續報告，2025財年公司整體員工離職率僅2.5%，約有五分之一員工任職超過10年，另有五分之二任職至少5年。
報告顯示，輝達2.5%的離職率明顯低於半導體業平均17%。
黃仁勳認為，員工之所以願意留下，不只是因為薪資，而是能夠在公司找到更深層的工作意義。
他表示，領導者最終目的，是替其他人創造實現夢想的條件。黃仁勳並將輝達形容為「全球最小的大公司」，認為管理階層應該建立良好的工作環境、降低組織層級帶來的阻礙，讓專業人才有機會將工作發展成「人生志業」。
在他看來，單純給員工一句「做得很好」相當容易，但真正能推動長期進步的，是投入時間提供具體、經過思考且具有建設性的回饋。

員工離職創業　黃仁勳照樣直接挑問題

這種直率風格也延伸至離開輝達、選擇自行創業的前員工。
例如，David Hoeller與Nikita Rudin曾在輝達機器人團隊工作多年，2024年離職創辦機器人新創公司。兩人原本計畫將公司命名為「Checkpoint」，但黃仁勳在慕尼黑一次深夜通話中直接告訴他們，這個名字很糟，應該更換。
兩人最終將公司改名為Flexion Robotics。Rudin也回憶，黃仁勳同時提醒他們，創業之路會比原先想像中困難得多。
另一名前員工Bing Xu的經歷，則更能體現黃仁勳對離職創業者的態度。
Xu 2024年因公司遭輝達收購而加入輝達，今年初決定離職創辦AI晶片軟體公司INT21，放棄一筆可能改變人生的輝達股權。INT21主要利用AI優化晶片軟體。
得知Xu的創業計畫後，黃仁勳與Xu及其他高階主管花了2個小時討論，甚至試圖說服他留在輝達。不過，黃仁勳也直接指出，溝通能力是Xu最大的弱點之一，可能限制他的發展。
黃仁勳認為，Xu經常假設其他人擁有與自己相同的技術知識，因此在解釋事情時容易讓人難以理解，並建議他留在輝達可能是更好的選擇。
Xu則形容，這是自己過去10年來收到最誠實的回饋。他後來與公關公司合作，希望改善溝通能力，並表示過去從未意識到溝通會成為如此大的問題，但黃仁勳的話讓他決定藉由創業機會讓自己變得更好。
這場談話也不只有批評。當時徐冰正受到高血壓等健康問題困擾，黃仁勳也勸他抽時間休息、調養。徐冰認為，這些關心與嚴格回饋都顯示黃仁勳希望他最終能夠成功。
黃仁勳對員工的高標準，同樣反映在他對自己的要求上。
他幾乎沒有傳統意義上的工作與生活平衡，全年投入工作，包括週末與假日。其中一個原因，是他始終擔心1993年創立的輝達可能隨時面臨失敗。
如今63歲的黃仁勳仍沒有退休計畫，甚至表示希望「在工作崗位上離世」。他坦言自己始終處於精疲力竭的狀態，但對失敗的恐懼、對合作夥伴的責任，以及對未來的願景，仍驅使他繼續站在第一線。
paras_en: Nvidia (NVDA-US) CEO Jensen Huang recently spoke unusually about his management philosophy. He admitted that he almost always critiques every piece of work his employees produce, describing this strict approach as "Taiwanese parental" discipline. Huang emphasized that this is not meant to punish staff but to point out issues immediately, giving them a chance to improve. He maintains the same direct feedback style with both current employees and former founders.

In an interview with CAN, Huang said that in Taiwanese parental thinking, there is rarely a moment when something is considered "good enough," so he almost never lets an employee present results without pointing out any problems.

Huang was born in 1963 in Taipei and moved to Tainan as a child; his father was a chemical engineer at a refinery. He has often spoken about Taiwanese parenting, noting that parents always want their children to do better, and he still receives advice from his father today.

However, Huang believes that the core of strict criticism is love and trust. He says that after giving feedback, he immediately returns to a caring stance, making it clear that the critique targets the work, not the person.
His management also stresses "real‑time feedback." As soon as a problem is spotted, it is raised on the spot rather than being accumulated for later, preventing small issues from growing larger.
Despite the high‑pressure style, Nvidia’s employee retention is remarkable.

According to Nvidia’s latest sustainability report, the overall employee turnover rate for fiscal year 2025 was only 2.5%, about one‑fifth of staff have been with the company for over ten years, and two‑fifths have stayed at least five years.
The report shows Nvidia’s 2.5% turnover is far below the semiconductor industry average of 17%.
Huang says employees stay not just for salary but because they find deeper meaning in their work at the company.

He states that a leader’s ultimate goal is to create conditions for others to realize their dreams, describing Nvidia as "the world’s smallest big company" and urging management to build a good work environment, reduce hierarchical obstacles, and let professionals turn their jobs into a life’s calling.
In his view, it’s easy to simply tell an employee "good job," but lasting progress comes from investing time to give concrete, thoughtful, constructive feedback.
This blunt style also extends to former employees who left Nvidia to start their own ventures.

For example, David Hoeller and Nikita Rudin, who spent years on Nvidia’s robotics team, left in 2024 to launch a robotics startup. They originally planned to name the company "Checkpoint," but Huang told them in a late‑night call from Munich that the name was terrible and should be changed.
They ultimately renamed the company Flexion Robotics. Rudin recalled that Huang also warned them that the entrepreneurial path would be far tougher than they expected.
Another former employee, Bing Xu, exemplifies Huang’s attitude toward departing founders.

Xu joined Nvidia in 2024 after his previous company was acquired, and early this year he decided to leave to start AI chip‑software firm INT21, turning down a potentially life‑changing Nvidia equity stake. INT21 focuses on using AI to optimize chip software.

When Huang learned of Xu’s plan, he and other senior leaders spent two hours discussing it and even tried to persuade him to stay at Nvidia. However, Huang also bluntly pointed out that Xu’s communication skills were a major weakness that could limit his growth.
Huang said Xu often assumes others share his technical knowledge, making his explanations hard to follow, and suggested staying at Nvidia might be a better option.

Xu described the feedback as the most honest he had received in ten years. He later worked with a PR firm to improve his communication and said he had never realized how big a problem it was, but Huang’s words motivated him to use the startup opportunity to become better.

The conversation wasn’t only criticism. At the time, Xu was dealing with hypertension and other health issues, and Huang urged him to take time to rest and recuperate. Xu felt that this concern combined with the strict feedback showed Huang’s desire for his ultimate success.
Huang’s high standards for employees also reflect his expectations of himself.

He essentially has no traditional work‑life balance, devoting the entire year to work, including weekends and holidays, partly because he constantly worries that Nvidia, which he founded in 1993, could fail at any moment.

Now 63, Huang still has no retirement plan and even says he hopes to "die at his desk." He admits he lives in a state of exhaustion, but fear of failure, responsibility to partners, and his vision for the future continue to drive him to stay on the front line.

items.title: 今年還能漲、明年恐摔21%！分析師示警美股已進入「泡沫末期」
items.title_en: Analysts Warn U.S. Stocks May Still Rise This Year but Could Drop 21% Next Year as They Enter the Late Stage of a Bubble
paras: 投資人或許應把握 2026 年最後幾個月的行情。分析師警告，由人工智慧（AI）帶動的美股多頭可能已進入泡沫末期，短線雖仍有上漲空間，但多項指標正逼近過往市場見頂前的極端水準。
Capital Economics 資深市場經濟學家 James Reilly 重申先前預測，標普 500 指數今年底可望升至 8,250 點，但到 2027 年底可能重挫 21%，降至 6,500 點。
Reilly 在最新報告中表示，綜合來看，目前數據符合「泡沫末期」特徵，多數觀察指標已達到或接近過去股市見頂前的水準。
首先是股票估值。目前市場經周期調整本益比（CAPE）已逼近網路泡沫高峰，標普 500 相對美國公債的估值也接近網路泡沫時期的極端水準。
企業獲利成長預期同樣偏高。標普 500 未來 12 個月每股盈餘（EPS）成長預期，已來到與網路泡沫高峰相當的水準。
AI燒錢潮能否持續成疑
另一項警訊來自龐大的 AI 投資。隨著科技巨頭持續大舉支出、自由現金流縮水，市場開始質疑這波 AI 資本支出的可持續性。預估到 2027 年，主要 AI 超大規模雲端業者的合計自由現金流將轉為負值。
此外，美股指數市值愈來愈集中於少數大型股票，集中度已升至極端水準。歷史經驗顯示，市場漲勢過度集中，往往與難以持續的多頭行情有關。
股票發行活動也快速升溫，符合泡沫末期常見特徵。隨著首次公開募股（IPO）及後續增資案蓄勢待發，市場即將迎來更多股票供給。過去類似的發行熱潮通常意味泡沫距離結束可能只剩數月，而非數年。
10年期美債殖利率5%成關鍵警戒線
Reilly 並未提及近期美債殖利率急升，但洛克斐勒國際（Rockefeller International）董事長 Ruchir Sharma 認為，這可能是另一項足以戳破泡沫的重要指標。
Sharma 近日在《金融時報》撰文警告，一旦美國 10 年期公債殖利率「明確突破」5%，AI 泡沫可能隨之破裂。5% 大致是網路泡沫時代以來，美國 10 年期公債殖利率波動區間的上緣。
Sharma 表示，美債殖利率突破 5%，意味資金環境進入更加緊縮的新時代，屆時大型 AI 計畫的融資難度將進一步提高。
如此高的借貸成本將從多方面衝擊 AI 熱潮。超大規模雲端業者可能減少發債籌措資本支出的規模，同時股票融資也會更加困難，因為歷史經驗顯示，殖利率高於 5% 往往會對股市形成壓力。
美國高負債放大利率衝擊
Sharma 指出，美債殖利率突破 5%，也將逐步逼近美國名目國內生產毛額（GDP）成長率，使政府債務的可持續性進一步惡化。
儘管華爾街部分人士認為，美債殖利率只是結束多年受央行政策壓抑後，逐漸回歸正常水準，但 Sharma 強調，如今美國對債務的依賴程度遠高於以往，債務規模已超過 GDP 的 100%。
他表示，因此目前的償債成本遠高於過去，政府借貸成本上升將更快擠壓其他借款人，並對已出現泡沫跡象的 AI 市場造成更大衝擊。
多頭派也開始提高警戒
就連長期看多美股的市場人士也開始變得更加謹慎。華爾街資深策略師 Ed Yardeni 已將本世紀剩餘時間延續「咆哮的 2020 年代」（Roaring 2020s）多頭情境的機率，由 80% 下調至 70%，同時將空頭情境的機率由 20% 提高至 30%。
Yardeni 在報告中坦言，近期油市與債市的發展確實令人不安。
paras_en: Investors might want to take advantage of the market in the final months of 2026. Analysts warn that the AI‑driven U.S. equity bull market may already be in the late stage of a bubble; while there is still short‑term upside, several indicators are approaching the extreme levels seen before past market peaks.

James Reilly, senior market economist at Capital Economics, reiterated his earlier forecast that the S&P 500 could reach 8,250 points by the end of this year, but may tumble 21% to around 6,500 points by the end of 2027.

Reilly said in his latest report that, taken together, the data now match the characteristics of a bubble’s late stage, with most observed metrics either at or near the levels that preceded previous market tops.

First, stock valuations. The cyclically adjusted price‑to‑earnings ratio (CAPE) has moved close to the peak seen during the dot‑com bubble, and the S&P 500’s valuation relative to U.S. Treasury yields is also near the extreme levels of that era.

Corporate earnings‑growth expectations are similarly lofty. The S&P 500’s projected earnings‑per‑share (EPS) growth over the next 12 months has risen to a level comparable to the dot‑com bubble’s peak.
The sustainability of the AI spending spree is now in doubt.

Another warning sign comes from the massive AI investment. As tech giants continue to spend heavily while free cash flow shrinks, the market is questioning whether this wave of AI capital spending can be sustained. It is estimated that by 2027 the combined free cash flow of the major ultra‑large AI cloud providers will turn negative.

In addition, the market‑cap concentration of U.S. equity indices is increasingly skewed toward a handful of large stocks, reaching extreme levels. Historical experience shows that an overly concentrated rally often coincides with a bull market that cannot be sustained.

Equity issuance activity is also heating up, a typical feature of a bubble’s late stage. With IPOs and follow‑on offerings gearing up, the market is about to see more shares supplied. Past similar issuance booms usually meant the bubble was only months away from ending, not years.
A 5% yield on the 10‑year U.S. Treasury becomes a key warning line.
Reilly did not mention the recent surge in Treasury yields, but Ruchir Sharma, chairman of Rockefeller International, believes this could be another crucial indicator capable of bursting the bubble.

Sharma wrote in the Financial Times that once the U.S. 10‑year Treasury yield “clearly breaks” the 5% mark, the AI bubble could collapse. The 5% level roughly marks the upper bound of Treasury yield fluctuations since the dot‑com era.
He explained that a yield breach of 5% would signal a tighter funding environment, making financing for large AI projects even more difficult.

Such high borrowing costs would hit the AI boom from multiple angles. Ultra‑large cloud providers might scale back bond issuance for capital spending, and equity financing would also become harder, as history shows yields above 5% tend to put pressure on stock markets.
The impact of high U.S. debt on interest rates.
Sharma noted that a 5% Treasury yield would also gradually approach the United States’ nominal GDP growth rate, further worsening the sustainability of government debt.

Although some Wall Street voices argue that Treasury yields are simply returning to normal after years of central‑bank suppression, Sharma emphasized that today’s U.S. reliance on debt is far higher than before, with debt now exceeding 100% of GDP.

He added that current debt‑service costs are much higher than in the past, and rising government borrowing costs will more quickly squeeze other borrowers and deal a bigger blow to the AI market, which already shows bubble signs.
Bull‑side participants are also raising their alerts.

Even long‑term bullish market participants are becoming more cautious. Ed Yardeni, a senior strategist on Wall Street, lowered the probability that the remainder of this century will continue the “Roaring 2020s” bull scenario from 80% to 70%, while raising the probability of a bear scenario from 20% to 30%.
Yardeni admitted in his report that recent developments in the oil and bond markets are indeed unsettling.

items.title: 道瓊創2008年來最糟9月開局 華爾街歷史再次重演
items.title_en: Dow Hits Worst September Start Since 2008, Wall Street History Repeats Itself
paras: 《MarketWatch》報導，華爾街的歷史正在重演。根據道瓊市場數據，道瓊工業平均指數周二(15日)創下2008年以來最差的9月前10個交易日表現。標普500指數與那斯達克綜合指數也創下2020年來最差的9月前10個交易日開局。
巧合的是，周二同時是雷曼兄弟(Lehman Brothers)申請破產18周年。這是2008年金融危機中一個關鍵轉捩點，並揭開了金融危機最嚴重的階段。根據FactSet資料，道瓊在2008年9月最終下跌6%，接著在同年10月進一步重挫超過14%。
股市本月截至目前表現不佳，其實並不令人意外。9月一直有「美股主指一年中表現最差月份」的名聲，而數據也支持這個說法。
從平均表現來看，9月是道瓊、標普500、那斯達克綜合指數及小型股羅素2000指數表現最差月份。
而且，9月也是唯一一個上述四大指數平均報酬率全部為負的月份。
Gibbens Capital Management投資長Mark Gibbens表示，「從歷史來看，9月一直是個表現不佳的月份，所以我們現在看到這種情況並不令人意外。」
但需要注意的是，不能把本月股市震盪單純歸因於「日曆」。Gibbens表示，就像「不幸福的家庭各有各的不幸」一樣，每一次股市糟糕的9月都有自己的原因。
而這次主要原因是，油價與債券殖利率上升，加上市場對AI的擔憂日益增加。
由於市場預期聯準會(Fed)將在周三升息，股市可能還會面臨更大的壓力。
Schwab Center for Financial Research宏觀研究與策略主管Kevin Gordon表示，「一方面，目前的就業環境仍相對具韌性，因此消費者每個月仍受惠於收入成長……但我不希望低估另一面的弱勢，包括聯準會可能轉向更加鷹派、長天期公債殖利率上升，以及汽油價格上漲所帶來的影響。」
「對我來說，這些因素加總起來，都會對風險資產形成逆風——不一定強到足以終結這波牛市，但肯定足以造成更大幅度的波動。」

2020年、2021年以及2022年9月，股市同樣表現不佳。2020年9月，股市在經歷一波強勁的夏季反彈後開始下跌。當時主要指數才剛大幅收復COVID-19疫情造成的跌幅。當時下跌的主要原因，包括美中關係緊張，以及美國國會遲遲無法通過新的COVID-19紓困刺激方案。而在2021年9月，新的COVID-19變種病毒出現，加上中國經濟出現疲軟跡象，這些因素共同推動股市下跌。當時股市此前同樣經歷了一段非常強勁的上漲行情。
2022年9月，投資人則受到時任聯準會主席鮑爾(Jerome Powell)在懷俄明州傑克森霍爾(Jackson Hole)發表的演講影響。鮑爾當時警告，美國家庭與企業短期內可能會承受一些痛苦，因為他承諾聯準會將繼續採取積極的升息措施來壓低通膨。而在那年夏季稍早，美國消費者物價通膨率一度達到40年來最高。
paras_en: MarketWatch reports that Wall Street history is repeating itself. According to Dow market data, the Dow Jones Industrial Average on Tuesday the 15th posted the worst performance for the first ten trading days of September since 2008. The S&P 500 and Nasdaq Composite also recorded their weakest September starts for the first ten trading days since 2020.

Coincidentally, Tuesday also marks the 18th anniversary of Lehman Brothers’ bankruptcy filing. That event was a pivotal turning point in the 2008 financial crisis and ushered in its most severe phase. FactSet data show the Dow fell 6% in September 2008 and then slumped another 14% in October of the same year.
The market’s lackluster performance so far this month is not surprising. September has long carried the reputation of being the worst month of the year for U.S. equities, and the data back that up.
On an average‑performance basis, September is the worst month for the Dow, the S&P 500, the Nasdaq Composite and the small‑cap Russell 2000 index.
Moreover, September is the only month in which the average returns of all four major indices are negative.
Mark Gibbens, CIO of Gibbens Capital Management, said, “Historically September has always been a weak month, so seeing this situation now is not unexpected.”

But it is important not to attribute this month’s market wobble solely to the calendar. Gibbens noted that, like “unhappy families each have their own misfortunes,” every bad September in the market has its own specific causes.
This time the main drivers are rising oil prices and bond yields, combined with growing concerns about artificial intelligence.
Because the market expects the Federal Reserve to raise rates on Wednesday, equities could face even more pressure.

Kevin Gordon, head of macro research and strategy at Schwab Center for Financial Research, said, “On one hand, the employment environment remains relatively resilient, so consumers continue to benefit from monthly income growth… but I don’t want to underestimate the downside, including a potentially more hawkish Fed, rising long‑term Treasury yields, and the impact of higher gasoline prices.”
“To me, all of these factors together create headwinds for risk assets—not necessarily strong enough to end this bull market, but certainly enough to trigger larger volatility.”

September 2020, 2021 and 2022 also saw weak market performance. In September 2020, the market fell after a strong summer rebound, just as the major indices were recouping the losses from the COVID‑19 pandemic. The decline was driven by heightened U.S.–China tensions and a delayed congressional COVID‑19 relief package. In September 2021, a new COVID‑19 variant emerged and China’s economy showed signs of weakness, pushing the market down after another robust rally earlier in the year.

In September 2022, investors were influenced by a speech from then‑Fed Chair Jerome Powell at Jackson Hole, Wyoming. Powell warned that U.S. households and businesses might endure short‑term pain as the Fed pledged to keep raising rates to curb inflation. Earlier that summer, U.S. consumer price inflation had peaked at its highest level in four decades.

items.title: 部分南非外國人士美簽遭限！魯比歐：政府未充分處理土地與種族政策相關疑慮
items.title_en: Some Foreign Nationals in South Africa Face U.S. Visa Restrictions; Rubio Says Government Has Not Adequately Addressed Land and Racial Policy Concerns
paras: 美國國務卿魯比歐(Marco Rubio)周二(15日)宣布，美國政府將對部分在南非的外國人士實施新的簽證限制，對象包括被美方認定須對制定或執行特定法律、政策負責，或與相關政策存在共同責任的人士。美方列出的政策涉及無償土地徵收、基於種族的歧視，以及煽動即將發生的暴力行為，尤其針對南非境內少數族群或種族群體。
魯比歐在聲明中表示，南非政府並未充分處理美方先前提出的相關疑慮，因此美國決定啟動新的簽證限制政策。此次措施針對的是「部分外國人士」而非全面限制所有南非國民，Reuters報導也未指出受影響人士的具體人數或公布完整名單。
根據美國國務院說法，新措施主要鎖定在南非境內、被認定涉及上述政策制定或執行的人士。限制範圍涵蓋「無償土地徵收」、「種族歧視」以及「煽動針對少數族群或種族群體的迫在眉睫暴力」等事項。
此次宣布也讓華盛頓與比勒陀利亞之間原本已經緊張的關係再度受到關注。Reuters指出，自川普第二任期開始後，美國與南非關係持續惡化，川普政府多次批評南非處理種族不平等問題的政策。
其中最受爭議的議題之一，是南非土地改革政策。南非今年通過新的土地徵收法律，允許政府在符合公共利益的情況下徵收土地，在特定條件下可以不提供補償。南非政府則表示，相關法律旨在處理殖民時期及種族隔離制度留下的土地分配不均問題。
Reuters此前報導指出，截至2025年初，南非政府尚未依這項法律實際徵收土地。法律同時要求政府在徵收前先嘗試與土地所有人達成協議，且土地徵收命令可以透過法院提出挑戰。南非政府因此否認外界所稱的任意土地沒收。
土地問題也成為川普政府與南非政府關係惡化的重要原因。2025年2月，川普曾表示將停止對南非提供未來援助，並要求調查他所提出的土地徵收及特定族群受到不公平對待等問題。當時美國政府資料顯示，美國2023年對南非提供的援助接近4.4億美元，其中約3.15億美元用於HIV/AIDS相關計畫。
不過，對南非而言，雙邊貿易的重要性也高於美國援助。Reuters此前報導，南非2023年出口至美國的商品中，約有150億美元規模，而其中約四分之一可透過非洲成長與機會法案(AGOA)享有優惠關稅待遇。南非政府估計，AGOA相關出口約占該國總出口的2%。
川普政府過去也曾提出對南非白人農民遭受迫害及暴力的指控，但南非政府否認存在針對白人的系統性迫害。Reuters在2025年報導指出，南非警方2024年記錄全國謀殺案件26,232起，其中與農業社區有關的案件為44起，農民受害者為8人。
2025年5月，川普與南非總統拉馬福薩(Cyril Ramaphosa)在白宮會面時，也曾公開討論土地及白人南非人的安全問題。拉馬福薩當時表示，南非確實面臨嚴重犯罪問題，但大多數犯罪受害者是黑人；南非政府則持續否認存在針對白人的種族滅絕。
這次簽證限制並未公布具體生效日期、受影響人數或個別人士名單。魯比歐的聲明主要說明政策鎖定的行為類型，因此目前尚不清楚美國政府將如何界定「負責」或「共同參與」相關法律及政策的人士，以及限制將適用哪些簽證類別。
此次措施也發生在美國近期持續收緊部分簽證政策之際。就在一天前，美國聯邦法官暫時阻止川普政府實施一項限制外國學生、交流訪客及記者在美停留期限的新規定。原規則原本計畫將F類學生簽證及J類交流訪客簽證的期限限制為4年，I類記者簽證則最多240天，但法院裁定該政策暫時不能實施。
南非目前也是美國在非洲的重要經貿夥伴之一。Reuters指出，美國是南非第二大貿易夥伴，僅次於中國，因此雙邊關係緊張不僅涉及外交與移民政策，也牽涉貿易、援助及投資等議題。
對此次最新措施，美國政府目前強調的是簽證限制本身，而非對所有南非人實施全面入境禁令。政策是否進一步擴大，以及南非政府是否採取外交或其他措施回應，仍有待後續發展。
paras_en: U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio announced on Tuesday the 15th that the United States will impose new visa restrictions on certain foreign individuals in South Africa, targeting those the U.S. deems responsible for drafting or implementing specific laws or policies, or who share responsibility for such policies. The policies cited involve gratuitous land expropriation, race‑based discrimination, and incitement of imminent violence, especially against minority or racial groups within South Africa.

Rubio said in his statement that the South African government has not sufficiently addressed the concerns previously raised by the United States, prompting Washington to launch the new visa restriction policy. The measure applies to “some foreign individuals” rather than a blanket ban on all South Africans, and Reuters did not specify how many people are affected or release a complete list.

According to the U.S. State Department, the new measures focus on individuals inside South Africa who are identified as being involved in the aforementioned policy formulation or enforcement. The restrictions cover “gratuitous land expropriation,” “racial discrimination,” and “incitement of imminent violence against minority or racial groups.”

The announcement also brings renewed attention to already‑tense relations between Washington and Pretoria. Reuters notes that relations have continued to deteriorate since the start of President Trump’s second term, with the Trump administration repeatedly criticizing South Africa’s handling of racial inequality issues.

One of the most contentious issues is South Africa’s land‑reform policy. This year the country passed a new land‑expropriation law that allows the government to seize land for public‑interest purposes without compensation under certain conditions. The government says the law is intended to address the unequal land distribution left over from the colonial and apartheid eras.

Reuters previously reported that, as of early 2025, the South African government had not yet carried out any expropriations under the new law. The legislation also requires the government to attempt a negotiated settlement with landowners before expropriation, and expropriation orders can be challenged in court. The government therefore denies claims of arbitrary land grabs.

Land issues have also been a major factor in the deterioration of Trump‑South Africa relations. In February 2025, Trump said he would halt future U.S. aid to South Africa and called for investigations into the land‑expropriation program and alleged unfair treatment of certain groups. At that time, U.S. data showed that aid to South Africa in 2023 was close to $440 million, about $315 million of which went to HIV/AIDS programmes.

However, bilateral trade matters more to South Africa than U.S. aid. Reuters earlier reported that South African exports to the United States in 2023 were roughly $15 billion, with about a quarter of that benefiting from preferential tariff treatment under the African Growth and Opportunity Act (AGOA). The government estimates AGOA‑related exports account for about 2 % of its total exports.

The Trump administration also previously alleged persecution and violence against white South African farmers, a claim the South African government rejects as unfounded. Reuters reported in 2025 that South African police recorded 26,232 murders nationwide in 2024, of which 44 were linked to agricultural communities and eight victims were farmers.

In May 2025, Trump and South African President Cyril Ramaphosa met at the White House and openly discussed land issues and the safety of white South Africans. Ramaphosa said South Africa does face serious crime problems, but most victims are Black, and the government continues to deny any systematic genocide against whites.

The visa restrictions were announced without a specific effective date, number of affected individuals, or a list of names. Rubio’s statement mainly outlines the types of conduct the policy targets, leaving it unclear how the U.S. will define “responsible” or “jointly involved” persons and which visa categories will be affected.

The move comes as the United States has recently tightened several visa programs. Just a day earlier, a federal judge temporarily blocked a Trump‑era rule that would have limited the stay periods for foreign students, exchange visitors and journalists in the U.S. The original rule sought to cap F‑student visas and J‑exchange visas at four years and limit I‑journalist visas to 240 days, but the court halted its implementation.

South Africa remains one of the United States’ key economic partners in Africa. Reuters notes that the United States is South Africa’s second‑largest trading partner after China, so heightened tensions involve not only diplomatic and immigration issues but also trade, aid and investment matters.

The U.S. government emphasizes that the latest action is a visa restriction, not a blanket entry ban on all South Africans. Whether the policy will be expanded and how the South African government will respond diplomatically or otherwise remains to be seen.

items.title: AI巨頭喊放慢開發但「不用擔心」？策略師直言「不太可能」、點背後原因
items.title_en: AI Giants Call for Slowing Development but "No Need to Worry"? Strategist Says "Unlikely" and Explains Why
paras: 人工智慧（AI）產業發展是否已經到了需要踩煞車的時刻，正逐漸成為華爾街關注焦點。包括 Anthropic 執行長阿莫戴（Dario Amodei）、OpenAI 執行長奧特曼（Sam Altman）及特斯拉(TSLA-US) 執行長馬斯克等科技業領袖近期相繼呼籲放慢 AI 開發腳步，投資人週一（15日）似乎開始重新評估這項風險。
根據《Business Insider》報導，AI 概念股當日遭到拋售，投資人開始思考若尖端 AI 實驗室真的放緩開發，可能對整體產業及資本支出熱潮造成的影響。
費城半導體指數收盤下跌5.86%，科技股占比較高的那斯達克100指數也一度跌逾1.6%，最後收盤則下跌0.82%。
此次 AI 產業領袖釋出的謹慎訊號，也正值前 Anthropic 研究員 Jacob Coxon 上週警告之際。Coxon 當時表示，AI 可能在未來10年內導致人類滅絕。
市場目前面臨的問題，是這些警告究竟會對 AI 投資熱潮造成多大影響。過去幾年，AI 資本支出（Capex）快速成長已成為推動市場的重要力量，即使投資人近來開始質疑如此龐大支出的投資報酬率，若相關支出突然急踩煞車，仍可能大幅改變 AI 交易背後的經濟邏輯。
不過，華爾街專業人士普遍對 AI 公司真的大幅放慢開發與支出的可能性抱持懷疑態度。
美股週一盤中跌勢也逐漸收斂，原先的跌幅隨著油價及債券殖利率從盤中高點回落而縮小，顯示當天市場走弱可能不完全是 AI 因素，也受到近幾週持續施壓股市的總體經濟因素影響。
Empower 首席投資策略師諾頓（Marta Norton）週一表示，AI 業者不太可能真正大幅放慢腳步，因為任何一家企業若選擇減速，都可能面臨被競爭對手超越的風險。
她認為，AI 業者近期的相關表態可能也具有「公關」層面的考量，「他們所說的與實際採取的行動，未必完全一致」，而產業競爭是推動 AI 持續發展的重要因素。
諾頓指出，各國政府同樣高度重視 AI 發展，這也構成推動產業持續前進的另一股力量。
Deepwater Asset Management 管理合夥人暨共同創辦人蒙斯特（Gene Munster）也認為，AI 公司幾乎不可能出現具規模的退縮。
他在社群平台 X 發文指出，其中一項原因是「囚徒困境」正在發揮作用：只要其中一家企業維持原有開發速度，其他選擇放慢腳步的公司就可能處於明顯劣勢。
另一項因素則是美中科技競爭。蒙斯特認為，美中競爭是真實存在的，至少美國必須維持與中國相當的發展速度。
美銀（Bank of America）研究分析師 Arya Vivek 在給客戶的報告中則表示，近期這些事件相較於 AI 長期發展趨勢而言只是「雜訊」。他預估，到本世紀末，AI 資本支出可能增加至3兆美元以上，達目前規模約3倍。
Arya 並指出，對美國政府而言，AI 已成為戰略優先事項，涉及與中國競逐科技領導地位、維持生產力及國內生產毛額（GDP）成長，以及鞏固美國在科技領域的領導地位。
儘管市場人士普遍不認為 AI 開發會立即大幅降溫，但 Nationwide 首席市場策略師 Hackett Mark 警告，真正值得關注的風險在於市場對 AI 的信心受到打擊。
他認為，即使業者實際上沒有大幅放慢 AI 開發，近期接連出現的高知名度警告仍可能加劇市場波動。
由於 AI 已經成為推動標普500指數上漲的重要力量，若投資人對 AI 領導企業、資料中心或相關融資的看法出現變化，市場可能出現遠超預期的劇烈波動。
另一方面，AlphaCore Wealth Advisory 首席投資策略師 Stubbs David 認為，週一股市下跌可能還受到其他因素影響，包括長天期美國國債殖利率持續走高，以及油價飆升。布蘭特原油盤中一度逼近每桶110美元，之後漲幅有所收斂。
在此背景下，諾頓建議投資人透過投資組合多元化，降低 AI 交易可能出現劇烈波動的影響。她指出，醫療保健股及歐洲股市對 AI 題材的曝險相對有限，可作為分散配置的方向。
Stubbs 則表示，工業金屬及黃金也是分散投資風險的選項，原因在於實體資產的需求仍然強勁。
paras_en: The question of whether the artificial intelligence (AI) industry has reached a point where it needs to hit the brakes is increasingly becoming a focus on Wall Street. Recent calls from tech leaders such as Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei, OpenAI CEO Sam Altman and Tesla (TSLA-US) CEO Elon Musk to slow AI development have prompted investors on Monday (the 15th) to start reassessing the risk.

According to Business Insider, AI‑related stocks were sold off that day as investors began to consider how a slowdown in cutting‑edge AI labs could affect the broader industry and the wave of capital spending it has spurred.
The Philadelphia Semiconductor Index closed down 5.86%, and the Nasdaq‑100, which is heavily weighted toward tech stocks, fell more than 1.6% at one point before ending the session down 0.82%.
The cautious signal from AI industry leaders comes at the same time that former Anthropic researcher Jacob Coxon warned last week that AI could lead to human extinction within the next ten years.

The market’s current dilemma is how much these warnings will dampen the AI investment frenzy. Over the past few years, rapid growth in AI capital expenditures (Capex) has been a key market driver, and even as investors now question the return on such massive spending, a sudden brake on that spending could still dramatically alter the economics behind AI trades.
Nevertheless, Wall Street professionals generally remain skeptical that AI companies will actually slow development and spending to a significant degree.

U.S. equities on Monday saw the intraday decline narrow as the initial drop was trimmed by falling oil prices and bond yields retreating from their intraday highs, suggesting that the market’s weakness that day was not solely an AI issue but also reflected broader macro‑economic pressures that have been weighing on stocks in recent weeks.
Empower’s chief investment strategist Marta Norton said on Monday that AI firms are unlikely to truly slow down, because any company that does so risks being overtaken by competitors.

She believes the recent statements from AI firms may also have a "public‑relations" angle – "what they say and what they actually do may not line up perfectly" – and that industry competition is a key driver of continued AI development.
Norton noted that governments around the world are also placing a high priority on AI development, providing another source of momentum for the sector.
Deepwater Asset Management managing partner and co‑founder Gene Munster also thinks it is almost impossible for AI companies to retreat on a large scale.
He posted on X that one reason is a "prisoner’s dilemma" at work: as long as one firm maintains its development pace, any company that slows down would be at a clear disadvantage.
Another factor is the U.S.–China technology rivalry. Munster said the competition is real and that the United States must at least keep pace with China’s development speed.

Bank of America analyst Arya Vivek wrote in a client note that recent events are merely "noise" compared with the long‑term AI development trend. He projects AI capital spending could rise to over $3 trillion by the end of the century, roughly three times its current size.

Vivek added that AI has become a strategic priority for the U.S. government, involving competition with China for tech leadership, maintaining productivity and GDP growth, and cementing America’s lead in technology.

Although market participants generally do not expect an immediate sharp cooling of AI development, Nationwide chief market strategist Hackett Mark warned that the real risk lies in a loss of confidence in AI among investors.
He said that even if firms do not actually slow AI development, the recent high‑profile warnings could still amplify market volatility.

Because AI has become a major engine driving the S&P 500 higher, a shift in investors’ views on AI‑leading companies, data‑center providers or related financing could trigger far‑greater than expected market swings.

On the other hand, AlphaCore Wealth Advisory chief investment strategist David Stubbs believes Monday’s market drop may also have been driven by other factors, including persistently rising long‑term U.S. Treasury yields and surging oil prices. Brent crude briefly approached $110 a barrel intraday before the rally eased.

In this context, Norton recommends investors diversify their portfolios to reduce the impact of potentially sharp AI‑related volatility. She points out that healthcare stocks and European equities have relatively limited exposure to AI themes and can serve as diversification targets.
Stubbs added that industrial metals and gold are also viable diversification options, as demand for physical assets remains strong.

items.title: 〈貴金屬盤後〉油價大漲助長升息機率 現貨黃金跌破4300美元
items.title_en: Precious Metals After Hours: Oil Price Surge Boosts Rate‑Hike Odds, Spot Gold Falls Below $4,300
paras: 金價周二(15日)下跌，主因是油價大漲帶來通膨升溫疑慮，強化了聯準會(Fed)本周升息的預期心理，美元及美債殖利率上揚，而不孳息的黃金則下跌。

黃金現貨下跌0.1%，報每盎司4293.29美元，盤中一度跌到8月7日以來最低。
美國黃金期貨收低0.4%，報每盎司4332.80美元。


StoneX資深市場策略師Daniel Pavilonis說：「能源價格上漲會導致更多通膨。更高的通膨可能推升利率。這對黃金不利……黃金目前處於區間震盪格局。如果利率持續走高，金價實際上可能進一步遭到拋售。」
交易員屏息以待Fed將於周三美東時間下午2時(台灣時間周四凌晨2時)公布的利率決策。金融市場目前押注，Fed決策官員將升息1碼(25個基點)至3.75-4.00%區間，並釋出未來進一步緊縮的訊號。
Pavilonis說：「我認為，很多(升息恐慌)已經反映在價格中……真正取決於Fed之後會說什麼。他們會繼續升息嗎？還是會觀察情勢？整體而言，這對黃金不是好兆頭。」
美元走強，使以美元計價的黃金對其他貨幣持有者而言更加昂貴。與此同時，美國10年期公債殖利率升至2007年以來最高水準。
黃金傳統上被視為對抗通膨與地緣政治不確定性的避險工具，但當無風險的美債殖利率走高，會降低黃金這類不孳息資產的吸引力。
ING分析師在一份報告中說：「Fed偏鷹風險大多已反映在價格中。不過，如果決策官員釋出利率將在更長時間維持高檔的訊號，黃金仍可能面臨壓力。」
油價上漲超過3美元，航運業消息人士表示，沙烏地阿拉伯紅海港口延布(Yanbu)的石油裝載作業已暫停。由於利比亞也已停止三座油田的作業，加劇市場對關鍵石油供應路線中斷可能持續數周的疑慮。

paras_en: Gold prices fell on Tuesday (the 15th), mainly because the sharp rise in oil prices has revived inflation concerns, strengthening expectations that the Federal Reserve will raise rates this week. The dollar and U.S. Treasury yields rose, while non‑yield‑bearing gold declined.

Spot gold slipped 0.1% to $4,293.29 per ounce, briefly hitting its lowest level since August 7. U.S. gold futures fell 0.4% to $4,332.80 per ounce. StoneX senior market strategist Daniel Pavilonis said, “Higher energy prices lead to more inflation. Higher inflation could push rates up, which is bad for gold… Gold is currently in a range‑bound pattern. If rates keep rising, gold could face further selling pressure.”

Traders are holding their breath for the Fed’s rate decision, scheduled for 2 p.m. Eastern Time on Wednesday (2 a.m. Taiwan time on Thursday). Markets are currently betting that officials will raise rates by one quarter‑point (25 basis points) to a 3.75‑4.00% range and signal further tightening ahead.

Pavilonis added, “I think a lot of the rate‑hike panic is already priced in… What really matters is what the Fed says afterward. Will they keep raising rates or just watch the data? Overall, that’s not a good sign for gold.”

A stronger dollar makes gold, which is priced in dollars, more expensive for holders of other currencies. At the same time, the yield on the U.S. 10‑year Treasury rose to its highest level since 2007.
Gold is traditionally viewed as a hedge against inflation and geopolitical uncertainty, but when risk‑free Treasury yields climb, the appeal of a non‑yielding asset like gold diminishes.

ING analysts wrote in a note that “most of the Fed’s hawkish risk is already reflected in prices. However, if policymakers signal that rates will stay high for a longer period, gold could still face pressure.”

Oil prices jumped more than $3, and shipping sources said loading operations at Saudi Arabia’s Yanbu port in the Red Sea have been halted. Libya has also shut down three oil fields, heightening worries that disruptions to key supply routes could last for weeks.
Other precious‑metal trading: Spot silver rose 0.3% to $63.41 per ounce. Spot platinum gained 0.7% to $1,772.32 per ounce. Spot palladium edged up 0.1% to $1,294.14 per ounce.

items.title: 美債殖利率衝破5%創19年新高 債市「逃逸速度」浮現進場契機
items.title_en: U.S. Treasury Yields Break 5%, Reaching 19‑Year High; Bond Market “Escape Velocity” Offers Entry Opportunity
paras: 《CNBC》報導，伊朗衝突推升油價與通膨疑慮，加上市場高度押注聯準會 (Fed) 週三升息1碼，帶動各期限美債殖利率全面攀升。美國10年期公債殖利率週二 (15 日) 衝破 5%，來到2007年以來最高。
債券價格雖持續承壓，但部分固定收益策略師認為，殖利率升至多年高點後，債券提供的利息收入已足以吸收部分價格跌幅，中期美債的風險報酬開始改善，投資人可重新評估配置機會。
油價與升息預期推高殖利率
10年期美債殖利率盤中最高觸及5.041%，創2007年7月以來最高，尾盤約報5.00%，較前一交易日上升逾3個基點。
對地緣政治風險較敏感的30年期美債殖利率，一度升至5.401%，創2007年6月以來最高；2年期殖利率則最高來到4.688%，寫下2024年7月以來新高。
市場目前預期，Fed結束為期兩天的政策會議後，將於週三升息1碼。CME FedWatch工具顯示，交易員押注升息25個基點的機率超過94%。
渣打銀行固定收益與外匯投資長Jonathan Liang 表示，美國10年期公債對通膨預期高度敏感，在各項通膨指標仍高於Fed的2%目標之際，兩者緊密連動的情況可望持續一段時間。
原油與美債殖利率相關性升至0.96
國際油價也是推升殖利率的重要因素。伊朗衝突延續、荷姆茲海峽實質受阻，西德州原油 (WTI) 週二再度突破每桶105美元。
美國與伊朗年初爆發戰爭後，油價一度急漲，隨後因雙方簽署備忘錄、外界期待衝突降溫，7月曾跌破每桶70美元。近期兩國重新發動攻擊，加上原油庫存下降，帶動能源價格再次走高。
柴油價格近期也突破每加侖6美元，進一步加劇通膨疑慮。
BMO Capital Markets數據顯示，近月WTI期貨與10年期美債殖利率的一個月滾動相關係數已升至0.96。
Interactive Brokers首席策略師Sosnick表示，油價走高通常會推升通膨預期，但目前地緣政治對油價及全球通膨的影響格外突出，使兩者關係較以往更加緊密。只要油價維持高檔甚至續漲，利率就會持續承受上行壓力。
不過，白宮國家經濟會議主任哈塞特 (Kevin Hassett) 認為，近期數據已顯示通膨正在放緩，這可能成為Fed官員反對升息的理由，但白宮仍會尊重Fed最終決定。
殖利率愈高 債券「價格緩衝」愈高
殖利率突破5%雖令市場不安，卻也提高債券的利息收入，使投資人承受價格下跌的能力優於2020年低利率時期。
Morningstar固定收益研究主管Lucas表示，隨著殖利率上升，債券目前擁有的價格緩衝已遠高於2020年。投資人若以100萬美元買進殖利率5%的10年期美債，每年可獲得約5萬美元利息，10年合計達50萬美元，對尋求低風險收入的高資產投資人更具吸引力。
Discipline Funds創辦人Roche以「逃逸速度」形容債券收益抵銷價格損失的臨界點。當債券殖利率與修正存續期間接近時，一年的利息收入便可能抵銷殖利率上升1個百分點造成的價格跌幅。
Roche指出，以目前利率水準來看，5年期以下債券已具備較充足的緩衝；期限愈長，抵禦殖利率進一步上升的能力則愈弱。
Glenmede投資策略副總裁Michael Reynolds舉例，若債券殖利率為4.90%、存續期間為5.8年，殖利率還可上升約0.84個百分點，價格損失才會抵銷一整年的利息收入。殖利率基準愈高，投資人判斷錯誤所付出的代價相對愈低。
7至10年期美債風險報酬轉佳
策略師普遍建議，對價格波動較敏感的投資人仍可優先配置短天期至中天期債券，降低殖利率繼續上升帶來的衝擊。
若能承受較高波動，則可考慮5至10年期債券。Reynolds認為，7至10年期區間目前提供較佳的風險報酬。
Global X投資策略主管Scott Helfstein建議，投資人可採取「債券梯」策略，分散布局5至10年期美國公債，以降低利率波動及單一進場時點的風險。
超短期債券仍是2026年最受歡迎的策略。iShares 0-3個月美國國債ETF (SGOV-US) 今年淨流入達410億美元，但Helfstein指出，期限略為拉長後，投資人可取得近20年來最具吸引力的殖利率。
投資人也可透過iShares 1-3年期美國國債ETF (SHY-US)、iShares 3-7年期美國國債ETF (IEI-US)，或涵蓋更廣泛債市的Vanguard整體債券市場ETF (BND-US)及iShares核心美國綜合債券ETF (AGG-US)參與市場。
5%無風險收益提高債券吸引力
Hightower Advisors首席投資策略師Link仍偏好股票的成長潛力，但坦言，10年期美債殖利率升至5%後，債券吸引力已明顯提高。
她表示，若5%殖利率維持3至6個月，將吸引更多投資人關注。過去因股市上漲而使股票比重偏高的投資組合，也可考慮實現部分獲利並轉進債券。
Link指出，只要通膨未失控，願意持有至到期的投資人可鎖定5%的低風險收益；若未來10年通膨維持在2%至3%，這項配置將更具吸引力。
paras_en: CNBC reports that the Iran conflict has pushed up oil prices and inflation concerns, and with the market heavily betting that the Fed will raise rates by one quarter‑point on Wednesday, yields on U.S. Treasuries of all maturities have risen across the board. The yield on the 10‑year U.S. Treasury broke the 5% mark on Tuesday (the 15th), the highest since 2007.

Although bond prices remain under pressure, some fixed‑income strategists say that once yields climb to multi‑year highs, the interest income from bonds is enough to absorb part of the price decline, improving the risk‑return profile of medium‑term Treasuries and giving investors a chance to reassess allocation opportunities.
Oil prices and rate‑hike expectations lift yields

The intraday high for the 10‑year Treasury yield reached 5.041%, the highest since July 2007, and it closed near 5.00% at the end of the session, up more than three basis points from the previous trading day.
The 30‑year Treasury, which is more sensitive to geopolitical risk, briefly rose to 5.401%, a peak not seen since June 2007; the 2‑year yield hit a high of 4.688%, the highest since July 2024.

The market currently expects the Fed, after concluding its two‑day policy meeting, to raise rates by one quarter‑point on Wednesday. The CME FedWatch tool shows that traders assign a greater than 94% probability to a 25‑basis‑point hike.

Jonathan Liang, head of fixed income and FX investments at Standard Chartered, said the 10‑year Treasury is highly sensitive to inflation expectations, and as long as inflation indicators remain above the Fed’s 2% target, the tight link between the two is likely to persist for some time.
The correlation between crude oil and Treasury yields has risen to 0.96

International oil prices are also a key driver of yields. Ongoing Iran tensions and a partial blockage of the Hormuz Strait have pushed West Texas Intermediate (WTI) crude above $105 per barrel again on Tuesday.

After the U.S. and Iran went to war at the start of the year, oil prices surged sharply, then fell below $70 per barrel in July as both sides signed a memorandum and markets hoped the conflict would cool. Recent renewed attacks and declining crude inventories have sent energy prices higher again.
Diesel prices have also broken $6 per gallon recently, further stoking inflation worries.
BMO Capital Markets data show that the one‑month rolling correlation between near‑month WTI futures and the 10‑year Treasury yield has climbed to 0.96.

Sosnick, chief strategist at Interactive Brokers, said higher oil prices usually lift inflation expectations, but the current geopolitical impact on oil and global inflation is unusually strong, making the relationship tighter than before. As long as oil stays high or climbs further, rates will continue to face upward pressure.

However, Kevin Hassett, director of the White House National Economic Council, noted that recent data show inflation is easing, which could give Fed officials a reason to resist further hikes, though the White House will still respect the Fed’s ultimate decision.
Higher yields mean a larger “price buffer” for bonds

While yields breaking 5% unnerves the market, they also raise the interest income from bonds, giving investors a better capacity to absorb price declines compared with the low‑rate environment of 2020.

Lucas, head of fixed‑income research at Morningstar, said that as yields rise, the price buffer that bonds now enjoy is far higher than in 2020. An investor who buys $1 million of 10‑year Treasuries yielding 5% would receive about $50,000 of interest each year, or $500,000 over ten years, making them more attractive to high‑net‑worth investors seeking low‑risk income.

Roche, founder of Discipline Funds, describes the point at which bond income offsets price loss as the “escape velocity.” When a bond’s yield approaches its modified duration, a year’s interest income can offset the price drop caused by a one‑percentage‑point rise in yield.
Roche added that at current rate levels, bonds with maturities under five years have a fairly ample buffer; the longer the maturity, the weaker the ability to withstand further yield increases.

Michael Reynolds, vice‑president of investment strategy at Glenmede, gave an example: if a bond yields 4.90% with a modified duration of 5.8 years, yields could rise roughly 0.84 percentage points before price losses would wipe out an entire year’s interest income. The higher the yield baseline, the lower the cost of a mis‑call by investors.
7‑ to 10‑year Treasuries offer improved risk‑return
Strategists generally advise investors who are sensitive to price swings to prioritize short‑ to medium‑term bonds to reduce the impact of further yield hikes.
Those who can tolerate higher volatility may consider 5‑ to 10‑year bonds. Reynolds believes the 7‑ to 10‑year segment currently offers the best risk‑return profile.

Scott Helfstein, head of investment strategy at Global X, recommends a “bond ladder” approach, spreading allocations across 5‑ to 10‑year U.S. Treasuries to mitigate interest‑rate volatility and timing risk.

Ultra‑short‑term bonds remain the most popular strategy for 2026. The iShares 0‑3 Month U.S. Treasury ETF (SGOV‑US) has seen net inflows of $41 billion this year, but Helfstein notes that extending the duration slightly gives investors access to the most attractive yields in the past two decades.

Investors can also gain exposure through the iShares 1‑3 Year Treasury ETF (SHY‑US), the iShares 3‑7 Year Treasury ETF (IEI‑US), or broader‑market funds such as Vanguard Total Bond Market ETF (BND‑US) and iShares Core U.S. Aggregate Bond ETF (AGG‑US).
A 5% risk‑free return boosts bond appeal

Link, chief investment strategist at Hightower Advisors, still favors the growth potential of equities but admits that once the 10‑year Treasury yield reaches 5%, bonds become markedly more attractive.

She says that if a 5% yield persists for three to six months, it will draw more investor attention. Portfolios that have become equity‑heavy due to recent stock gains could consider taking some profits and shifting into bonds.

Link adds that as long as inflation remains under control, investors willing to hold to maturity can lock in a low‑risk 5% return; if inflation stays in the 2‑3% range over the next decade, the allocation becomes even more compelling.

items.title: 比特幣因Clarity法案未推進下跌 伍德正拋售加密貨幣股？
items.title_en: Bitcoin Falls as Clarity Act Stalls, Is Cathie Wood Selling Crypto Stocks?
paras: 《巴隆周刊》報導，對加密貨幣監管相當關鍵的「清晰法案」(Clarity Act)周二(15日)未能在美國參議院取得進展。
參議院當天進行「終止辯論」(cloture)的程序性表決。如果表決通過，法案就能進一步進入最終表決階段。但最終投票結果為49票贊成、50票反對，因此法案未能繼續推進。
比特幣及與加密貨幣高度相關股票大幅下跌。加密貨幣交易所Coinbase(COIN-US)股價大跌10%，至172.25美元。
這也使Coinbase成為當天標普500指數中跌幅最大的股票。事實上，過去幾個月加密貨幣相關股票曾大幅上漲，因市場認為Clarity Act通過的可能性重新燃起。
這次表決結果非常接近。共和黨參議員直到最後一刻都還在努力爭取民主黨議員的支持，希望能讓法案獲得足夠票數。但根據預測市場Polymarket，周二市場認為Clarity Act今年通過的機率已從周一的31%降至19%。
比特幣跌至76,092美元，跌幅接近4%。雖然比特幣從7月初至今仍上漲超過25%，但若從2026年初計算，目前仍下跌約14%。
第二大加密貨幣以太幣(Ethereum)下跌超過6%，來到2,411美元。熱門「山寨幣」XRP更下跌近12%，至1.29美元。
持有比特幣規模最大的公司Strategy(MSTR-US)，股價下跌5.4%。其周一才上漲4.6%，如今又回吐部分漲幅。
根據一份交易通知，知名投資人伍德(Cathie Wood)旗下方舟投資(ARK Invest)周一趁機賣出了加密貨幣相關股票。ARK 旗下基金出售了CoinDesk母公司 Bullish(BLSH-US)、Coinbase、穩定幣發行商Circle Internet(CRCL-US)，以及以太幣財庫公司Bitmine Immersion Technologies(BMNR-US)的股票。
paras_en: Baron Weekly reported that the “Clarity Act,” a key piece of cryptocurrency regulation, failed to make progress in the U.S. Senate on Tuesday, the 15th.
The Senate held a procedural cloture vote that day. If the vote had passed, the bill would have moved to a final vote, but the result was 49 in favor and 50 against, so the bill did not advance.
Bitcoin and stocks closely tied to crypto plunged sharply. Shares of cryptocurrency exchange Coinbase (COIN‑US) tumbled 10% to $172.25.
This also made Coinbase the biggest decliner in the S&P 500 that day. In fact, crypto‑related stocks had surged in recent months as the market revived hopes that the Clarity Act would pass.

The vote was extremely close. Republican senators fought until the last minute to win Democratic support and secure enough votes, but according to Polymarket predictions, the market’s estimate of the Clarity Act passing this year fell from 31% on Monday to 19% on Tuesday.
Bitcoin fell to $76,092, down nearly 4%. Although Bitcoin has risen more than 25% since early July, it is still about 14% lower than its level at the start of 2026.
The second‑largest cryptocurrency, Ethereum, dropped more than 6% to $2,411, while the popular “altcoin” XRP slid almost 12% to $1.29.
MicroStrategy (MSTR‑US), the company with the largest Bitcoin holdings, saw its stock fall 5.4%. It had risen 4.6% on Monday and is now giving back part of that gain.

According to a trading notice, prominent investor Cathie Wood’s ARK Invest sold crypto‑related stocks on Monday. ARK’s funds disposed of shares in Bullish (BLSH‑US), the parent of CoinDesk, Coinbase, stablecoin issuer Circle Internet (CRCL‑US), and Ethereum‑focused Bitmine Immersion Technologies (BMNR‑US).

items.title: 摩根士丹利看亞洲科技投資機會：台灣已深度融入全球科技股交易
items.title_en: Morgan Stanley Sees Asian Tech Investment Opportunities: Taiwan Deeply Integrated into Global Tech Stock Trading
paras: 2026年09月16日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 摩根士丹利Morgan Stanley(MS-US)認為，亞洲股票市場仍存在長期成長機會，其中台灣憑藉科技產業的重要地位，已深度融入全球科技股投資主題。
摩根士丹利共同總裁Daniel Simkowitz在Barclays Global Financial Services Conference表示，亞洲股票市場正在展現更廣泛的活力，日本市場相較5至6年前明顯復甦，韓國市場也重新受到關注，而台灣則「深度融入科技股交易（embedded in the technology trade）」。
Simkowitz指出，大中華區市場正積極尋求經濟成長動能，國際投資人也希望參與亞洲市場機會，印度同樣具備後續發展潛力。從摩根士丹利的布局來看，日本、韓國、台灣、大中華區及印度，都是亞洲股票市場長期發展的重要區塊。
摩根士丹利並認為，目前AI投資週期仍處於相對早期至中期階段。公司觀察到AI基礎建設仍存在龐大需求，相關資本支出尚處早期，且股權與信用市場都將參與AI基礎建設融資。從全球科技投資週期延續的角度來看，這也使深度參與科技產業的台灣市場持續具有觀察價值。

paras_en: September 16, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center report) – Morgan Stanley (MS-US) believes that Asian equity markets still hold long‑term growth opportunities, and Taiwan, thanks to the importance of its technology sector, is already deeply embedded in the global tech‑stock investment theme.

Morgan Stanley co‑president Daniel Simkowitz said at the Barclays Global Financial Services Conference that Asian equity markets are showing broader vitality, with Japan’s market clearly recovering compared with five to six years ago, Korea’s market regaining attention, and Taiwan being “embedded in the technology trade.”

Simkowitz noted that the Greater China region is actively seeking economic growth drivers, international investors want to tap Asian market opportunities, and India also has further development potential. From Morgan Stanley’s perspective, Japan, Korea, Taiwan, Greater China and India are all key blocks for the long‑term development of Asian equity markets.

Morgan Stanley also believes that the AI investment cycle is still in a relatively early‑to‑mid stage. The firm observes that demand for AI infrastructure remains massive, related capital expenditures are still in their infancy, and both equity and credit markets will participate in financing AI infrastructure. Viewed in the context of the ongoing global tech investment cycle, this keeps Taiwan’s market, which is deeply involved in the tech industry, of continued interest.

items.title_en: Pre‑market Taiwan Stock News: TSMC Dividend Show, Foreign Investors Sell NT$227.2 billion in Four Days, MediaTek Unveils 2‑nm Dimensity 9600 Pro
paras: 9/16台股盤前要聞

paras_en: Pre‑market news for Taiwan stocks on September 16.

On the 15th, Taiwan’s stock market volume hit the second‑lowest level of the year, and the 46,000‑point threshold was briefly reclaimed then lost, closing at 45,511 points, down 351 points, testing the seasonal‑line support. All three major institutional investors were net sellers, indicating relatively low willingness to hold shares. Foreign investors targeted second‑tier wafer‑foundries for withdrawals, net‑selling a total of 95,000 contracts of TSMC and UMC, and simultaneously rebalanced active‑style, index‑type and high‑dividend ETFs – five of the top‑ten net‑selling stocks were ETFs, amounting to a total adjustment of 186,000 contracts.

On September 16 the market will host a heavyweight dividend‑ex‑date event. The Taiwan Stock Exchange announced that three weighted‑index component stocks – TSMC (2330‑TW), Material‑KY (4763‑TW) and Lichi (1517‑TW) – will undergo dividend‑ex‑date trading on that day. The dividend payouts will reduce the market‑capitalisation‑weighted index by an estimated 56.59 points, with TSMC alone accounting for about 55.64 points of the decline.

TSMC’s Executive Vice President and Co‑COO Mi Yu‑chie held a dialogue with National Taiwan University students on the 15th, discussing the development and risks of artificial intelligence (AI). He described current AI as “like a three‑year‑old Superman” – extremely powerful but also capable of producing unknown outcomes. Recent warnings from CEOs of AI firms such as Anthropic and OpenAI have reinforced TSMC’s cautious stance on using AI tools for sensitive R&D information.

MediaTek (2454‑TW) officially launched its next‑generation flagship mobile chipset series, the Dimensity 9600, on the 15th. The top‑end Dimensity 9600 Pro uses TSMC’s 2‑nm process for the first time and incorporates a full‑big‑core CPU and a native AI architecture, marking MediaTek’s entry into the 2‑nm era. Apple recently announced its 2‑nm A20 Pro chip for the upcoming iPhone 18 Pro series, so the two major smartphone‑chip camps will now face off directly at 2 nm. Phones equipped with MediaTek’s new chip could be on sale in Taiwan as early as October.

Thirteen listed financial holding companies disclosed their full‑year‑2026 earnings for August. Benefiting from the Taiwan market rebound, strong AI‑related stocks and active capital‑market trading, the holdings saw a profit surge. The combined after‑tax net profit for the month reached NT$86.126 billion; cumulative after‑tax profit for the first eight months surpassed NT$570 billion, climbing to NT$578.907 billion – a year‑over‑year increase of nearly 60% and a record high for the same period. Fubon Financial (2881‑TW) reclaimed the title of highest monthly profit, and its cumulative profit and EPS remain the best among holdings. Five firms – Taishin‑Shinkong (2887‑TW), Yuanta (2885‑TW), KGI (2883‑TW), Yongfeng (2890‑TW) and Guo Piao (2889‑TW) – each earned more this year than they did in the entire previous year.

U.S. Treasury yields broke the 5% mark and the U.S. dollar index kept strengthening, deepening market expectations of further Federal Reserve rate hikes. Ahead of major central‑bank rate decisions, hedge‑fund sentiment surged, and Asian equities were broadly weak on the 15th. Taiwan’s market also suffered a “stock‑and‑currency double‑kill”: the New Taiwan dollar fell more than 0.20 NTD against the U.S. dollar, closing at 31.848 NTD, down 0.16 NTD, marking a fourth consecutive depreciation, the largest single‑day drop in over six months and the lowest level in nearly three weeks.

The Ministry of Finance announced on the 15th the final anti‑dumping investigation results for cold‑rolled non‑grain-oriented electrical steel imported from South Korea and mainland China. Both countries’ exporters were found to be dumping. The Korean firms showed the highest dumping margin at 59.35%, while Chinese firms recorded a margin of 26.44%. Customs has been instructed to levy provisional anti‑dumping duties based on these final margins, and the case has been forwarded to the Ministry of Economic Affairs for a final determination of national economic interest and industry damage. A decision on the formal duty rate is expected within 50 days.
46,000 points cannot be reclaimed; foreign investors sold NT$227.2 billion over four days, withdrawing a total of 95,000 contracts of TSMC and UMC.
NTD‑linked “stock‑and‑currency double‑kill”: the central bank’s pre‑week‑end panic led to a 0.16 NTD drop, the biggest depreciation in nearly six months.

Thirteen financial holdings posted a combined NT$578.9 billion profit for the first eight months, a new high; Fubon Financial returned to the triple‑crown; five firms out‑earned the entire previous year.
MediaTek’s 2‑nm Dimensity 9600 Pro unveiled, set to challenge Apple’s A20; phones could launch as early as October.
Mi Yu‑chie responded to AI giants: “AI is like a three‑year‑old Superman – very powerful but may also bring unknown results.”
Three stocks including TSMC will have dividend‑ex‑date on September 16; the index is expected to lose more than 56 points.
Strong August: Fubon Financial earned NT$120.2 billion in the first eight months, affecting retained earnings by NT$233.68 billion – a record impact.
The finance ministry approved anti‑dumping duties on South Korean and Chinese electrical steel, with the highest provisional duty reaching 59%.
Ye Jun‑hsian estimates Taiwan’s GDP could reach 12% this year, with mild inflation akin to a normal body temperature becoming the new norm.

items.title: 金控董座也難逃「仿冒」！期交所8月接獲577件社群詐騙通報 「兩地」成重災區
items.title_en: Even Financial Holding Chairmen Aren’t Safe from Impersonation! Futures Exchange Receives 577 Community Scam Reports in August, “Two Regions” Are Hotspots
paras: 台股近期交投熱絡且高檔震盪，詐騙集團趁勢猖獗，連打詐最力的兆豐金 (2886-TW) 董事長董瑞斌也遭冒名發送信件要求加LINE建立群組。期交所15日公布最新統計指出，期貨商8月蒐報檢舉社群平台疑似期貨詐騙案件數持續上升，累計通報達577件，其中以假冒合法期貨商及營業員身分誘騙民眾最為猖獗，臉書與Threads成重災區，提醒投資人切勿輕信來歷不明訊息。
兆豐銀行表示，日前有不明人士以電子郵件冒用「兆豐銀行董事長董瑞斌」名義，要求收件者建立 LINE 群組並提供 QR Code，兆豐銀澄清非該行發出，屬不法詐騙行為，請社會大眾務必提高警覺。並提醒兩點：一、董事長及該行同仁不會以私人電子郵件帳號（如 Gmail 等）或非正式管道，要求建立通訊群組、提供 QR Code、或交辦任何工作事項；二、如收到可疑訊息，請勿回覆、勿點擊連結、勿提供個人資料。
期交所表示，8月疑似詐騙案件中，臉書投資社團貼文占比最高達60%，Threads串文則超過30%。歸納常見手法主要有三類：第一，假借分享投資獲利或「高勝率訊號」誘騙加LINE；第二，非法平台以「最低交易0.1口」、「免保證金」等話術吸引小資族；第三，冒用合法業者身分博取信任。
為強化第一線防詐量能，期交所自115年3月至9月推動反詐治理評鑑活動，要求業者建置反詐基礎建設、主動檢舉社群詐騙並加強宣導。截至8月底，期貨商已舉辦33場創新反詐活動，觸及超過8000人。其中凱基期貨自製趣味饒舌短影音說明詐騙手法，在雙平台累計瀏覽破15萬人次，成為亮點案例。
期交所強調，期貨交易具高槓桿與高風險特性，民眾務必透過合法管道交易，切勿將資金匯入個人帳戶或下載不明軟體。面對可疑資訊，應謹記「查證、確認、冷靜」三原則，可撥打165反詐騙專線或至數位發展部網路詐騙通報查詢網查證，共同維護健全的交易環境。
paras_en: Taiwan’s stock market has been active and trading at high levels, prompting scam groups to ramp up their activities. Even the chairman of Mega Financial Holding (2886‑TW), Dong Rui‑bin, was impersonated in a letter demanding the creation of a LINE group. The Futures Exchange announced on the 15th that reports of suspected futures scams on social platforms kept rising in August, with a cumulative total of 577 cases. The most common fraud involves pretending to be legitimate futures firms or brokers, with Facebook and Threads identified as the hardest‑hit platforms. Investors are warned not to trust messages of unknown origin.

Mega Financial Bank said that an unknown party recently used the name of its chairman, Dong Rui‑bin, in an email that asked recipients to set up a LINE group and provide a QR code. The bank clarified that it never sent such a request and labeled the act as illegal fraud, urging the public to stay vigilant. It added two reminders: the chairman or any staff will never use personal email accounts (such as Gmail) or informal channels to request the creation of communication groups, QR codes, or any work‑related tasks; and if a suspicious message is received, do not reply, click any links, or provide personal information.

The Futures Exchange reported that in August, posts in Facebook investment groups accounted for the highest share of suspected scams at 60%, while Threads threads made up over 30%. It identified three common tactics: first, fraudsters pose as sharers of investment profits or “high‑success‑rate signals” to lure victims into adding them on LINE; second, illegal platforms attract small investors with pitches like “minimum trade of 0.1 contract” or “no margin required”; third, impersonating legitimate firms to gain trust.

To boost frontline anti‑fraud capacity, the Futures Exchange has been running an anti‑fraud governance assessment from March to September 2026, requiring firms to build basic anti‑fraud infrastructure, proactively report community scams, and strengthen education. By the end of August, futures firms had held 33 innovative anti‑fraud events reaching over 8,000 people. Notably, KGI Futures produced a fun rap‑style short video explaining scam tactics, which amassed more than 150,000 views across two platforms, becoming a standout case.

The Futures Exchange emphasized that futures trading involves high leverage and high risk, and the public must trade through legitimate channels, never transferring funds to personal accounts or downloading unknown software. When encountering suspicious information, one should follow the three principles of “verify, confirm, stay calm,” and can call the 165 anti‑fraud hotline or visit the Ministry of Digital Development’s online scam reporting site to verify, helping to maintain a healthy trading environment.

items.title: 台達電子公司發行15億美元海外可交換債 充實營運資金
items.title_en: Delta Electronics Issues $1.5 Billion Overseas Exchangeable Bonds to Strengthen Working Capital
paras: 台達電(2308-TW)今(15)日公告，新加坡子公司DEISG以所持有的Delta Electronics (Thailand)（泰達電，DET）股份作為交換標的，發行總額15億美元（約新台幣478億元）的海外可交換債，募集資金將用於充實既有業務及強化未來拓展所需營運資金。
本次可交換債分為A、B兩券，其中A券發行規模5億美元，年期1年；B券發行規模10億美元，年期5年，兩券票面利率均為0%，並依面額100%發行。
本次可交換債預計自2026年11月1日起進入交換期間。其中，A券初始交換價格為每股266.80泰銖，較參考價格溢價15%；B券初始交換價格為每股301.60泰銖，較參考價格溢價30%。A券持有人每20萬美元本金可初步交換24,856.8966股DET股份，B券則可交換21,988.7931股，後續將依債券條款進行調整。
另外，A券到期日為2027年9月21日，B券到期日則為2031年9月21日。值得注意的是，兩券到期贖回價格均低於面額，A券將依發行本金98.01%贖回，B券則依發行本金97.53%贖回。此外，B券持有人可在發行屆滿1.5年及3年時，分別要求以本金99.25%及98.51%的價格贖回全部或部分B券。
paras_en: Delta Electronics (2308‑TW) announced today (the 15th) that its Singapore subsidiary DEISG will issue overseas exchangeable bonds totaling US$1.5 billion (approximately NT$47.8 billion) using its holdings of Delta Electronics (Thailand) (DET) shares as the exchange target. The proceeds will be used to reinforce existing operations and to fund the working capital needed for future expansion.

The exchangeable bonds are divided into two series, A and B. Series A has an issuance size of US$500 million with a one‑year term, while Series B totals US$1 billion with a five‑year term. Both series carry a 0% coupon and are issued at 100% of face value.

The exchange period is expected to begin on November 1, 2026. The initial exchange price for Series A is THB 266.80 per share, representing a 15% premium to the reference price; for Series B the initial price is THB 301.60 per share, a 30% premium. Holders of Series A can initially exchange US$200,000 of principal for 24,856.8966 DET shares, while Series B holders can exchange the same amount for 21,988.7931 shares, subject to adjustments under the bond terms.

Series A matures on September 21, 2027, and Series B on September 21, 2031. Notably, both series will be redeemed at prices below par: Series A at 98.01% of the principal amount and Series B at 97.53%. Additionally, Series B holders may request redemption of all or part of their bonds at 99.25% of principal after 1.5 years and at 98.51% after three years from issuance.

items.title: 〈房產〉翔耀子公司勁耘科技9.2億元標脫新營產業園區4892坪工業廠地
items.title_en: <Real Estate> Xiangyao subsidiary Jinyun Technology sells 920 million NTD industrial land in Xinying Industrial Park, 4,892 ping
paras: 上市光電業翔耀實業(2438-TW)子公司勁耘科技委託和氏璧國際物業，標售辦理位於台南市新營產業園區4892坪工業廠地，在今(15)日完成開標並順利標脫，標售價格達9.2億元，得標廠商爲榮眾科技。
翔耀子公司勁耘科技公開標售的台南新營產業園區土地總面積約4892坪、建物總面積約3815坪，由新中路5號及四維路22號兩座廠區組成，標售底價8.2億元，今天以9.2億元完成標售成交，溢價率達12.2%；按土地面積換算，成交總價約為每坪16.5萬元。
勁耘科技公開標售的台南新營產業園區土地本案除基地規模接近5,000坪，並具備既有廠房、雙廠配置及可加速企業進駐等條件。在大型工業土地供給有限的市場環境下，順利標脫也反映企業對於具備立即使用條件的工業不動產，仍有明確且實質的需求。
勁耘科技過去主要營收來源，包含面板相關回收、酸洗及相關勞務收入。近年受到產業結構變化、部分大廠產能調整及市場需求轉變影響，原有業務規模已較過去明顯下降，短期內回復過往營運規模的不確定性較高。基於資產使用效益、集團資金配置及整體營運轉型考量，勁耘科技經審慎評估後，透過公開標售方式活化相關不動產資產。
台南工業不動產市場近年受南部產業投資、半導體供應鏈擴張、台商回流及企業分散生產基地等因素帶動，工業地價呈現上升趨勢。根據內政部公布的都市地價指數，2024年上半年台南市工業區地價指數年增約4.1%，當時漲幅居全台各縣市之首，顯示產業投資已由南科核心逐步向周邊工業聚落及交通節點擴散。
台南新營產業園區為南台灣發展成熟的製造業聚落，園區面積約124公頃，主要涵蓋金屬製品、基本金屬、機械設備、塑膠及化學製品等產業。園區鄰近國道1號新營交流道，具備南北運輸便利性，可串聯台南與嘉義產業軸帶，對重視供應鏈效率及區域布局的企業具有區位優勢。
和氏璧國際物業總經理詹桂綺表示，標脫此一案件不是單純以土地單價出售廠地，而是將既有廠房、雙廠配置、交通條件及成熟產業聚落等優勢，轉化為買方可以衡量的營運價值。對企業而言，若能縮短一至兩年的覓地、規劃及建廠時程，其所創造的效益，往往遠高於土地單價本身的差異。
詹桂綺進一步指出，近年企業評估工業不動產時，已由過去單純比較土地價格，轉向綜合考量「進駐時程、營運效率、建置成本、供應鏈位置及資產稀缺性」。尤其在營建成本上升、設廠審查時間拉長的情況下，具備合法既有廠房、完整產權及一定基地規模的工業資產，市場競爭力更加明顯。
新營位於台南與嘉義產業軸帶之間，除擁有成熟的工業聚落，台南市政府亦持續推動新營交流道特定區及北核心2-1產業園區等開發計畫。此一大型工業廠地順利標脫，不僅反映市場對可立即使用工業資產的實質需求，也顯示台南工業不動產需求正由南科及市區周邊，逐步向具交通優勢與產業基礎的溪北地區延伸。
paras_en: Xiayao Industrial (2438-TW) subsidiary Jinyun Technology commissioned He Shibi International Property to auction off an industrial plot of 4,892 ping located in Xinying Industrial Park, Tainan City. The bidding closed today (the 15th) and the plot was successfully sold for 920 million NTD to the winning bidder, Rongzhong Technology.

Jinyun Technology’s publicly auctioned land in Xinying Industrial Park covers about 4,892 ping of land and about 3,815 ping of building area, consisting of two factories at No.5 Xinzhong Road and No.22 Siwei Road. The reserve price was 820 million NTD; the final sale price of 920 million NTD represents a 12.2% premium, or roughly 165,000 NTD per ping when calculated on land area alone.

The Xinying Industrial Park land offered by Jinyun Technology is nearly 5,000 ping in size and includes existing factories, a dual‑plant layout and conditions that can accelerate corporate entry. In a market where large‑scale industrial land is scarce, the successful sale reflects a clear and tangible demand for industrial real estate that is ready for immediate use.

Jinyun Technology’s main revenue historically came from panel‑related recycling, pickling and related services. In recent years, industry restructuring, capacity adjustments by major manufacturers and shifting market demand have markedly reduced its business scale, making a short‑term recovery uncertain. Considering asset utilization, group capital allocation and overall operational transformation, Jinyun Technology carefully evaluated and decided to revitalize the property through a public auction.

The Tainan industrial real‑estate market has been buoyed in recent years by southern industrial investment, semiconductor supply‑chain expansion, the return of Taiwanese firms and the dispersal of production bases, driving up industrial land prices. According to the Ministry of the Interior’s urban land‑price index, the industrial‑area price index in Tainan rose about 4.1% year‑on‑year in the first half of 2024, the highest growth rate among all Taiwanese counties and cities, indicating that investment is spreading from the core of Southern Taiwan Science Park to surrounding industrial clusters and transport nodes.

Xinying Industrial Park is a mature manufacturing hub in southern Taiwan, covering roughly 124 hectares and hosting industries such as metal products, basic metals, machinery, plastics and chemicals. The park is adjacent to the Xinying interchange of National Highway No.1, offering convenient north‑south transport links that connect Tainan and Chiayi industrial corridors, giving companies a locational advantage for supply‑chain efficiency and regional layout.

He Shibi International Property’s general manager, Zhan Guìqí, said the sale was not merely a transaction of land price per ping, but a conversion of the existing factories, dual‑plant configuration, transport advantages and mature industrial cluster into measurable operational value for the buyer. For a company, shortening the land‑search, planning and construction timeline by one to two years can generate benefits far exceeding the price difference of the land itself.

Zhan added that in recent years, companies evaluating industrial real estate have shifted from simply comparing land prices to a comprehensive assessment of "entry timing, operational efficiency, construction cost, supply‑chain location and asset scarcity." Especially as construction costs rise and plant‑approval times lengthen, industrial assets with legal existing factories, clear title and a substantial site size become markedly more competitive in the market.

Xinying sits between the Tainan and Chiayi industrial corridors and, besides its mature industrial cluster, the Tainan municipal government continues to promote development projects such as the Xinying interchange special zone and the North Core 2‑1 industrial park. The successful sale of this large industrial site not only reflects market demand for immediately usable industrial assets but also shows that demand for Tainan industrial real estate is shifting from the Southern Taiwan Science Park and city‑center areas toward the north‑river region with its transport advantages and industrial foundation.

items.title: 訂單回來、價格也漲了，獲利為何反而探底？這家UPS大廠明年拚翻身、後年拚長期成長機會
items.title_en: Orders Are Returning and Prices Are Rising, Yet Profits Are Falling: This UPS Giant Aims for a Turnaround Next Year and Long‑Term Growth the Year After
paras: 2026年09月15日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 中東戰事看似與台灣UPS產業相隔甚遠，卻已一路影響旭隼(6409-TW)的獲利。關鍵在於旭隼除了UPS，還有相當比重的逆變器(Inverter)業務，而逆變器主要市場集中於新興國家，因此當地需求與海運一旦受到地緣政治干擾，很快就會反映在公司營運。
更值得注意的是，旭隼2026年UPS需求其實正在回溫，公司也已透過漲價轉嫁成本，但法人預估全年獲利仍將降至近三年低點，形成「營收恢復成長、獲利反而探底」的反差。

UPS需求回來了，公司也開始漲價
旭隼2026年第2季營收55.54億元，季增率32.1%，主要受惠On-Line及Off-Line UPS庫存回補。其中On-Line UPS占營收40.1%、Off-Line UPS占27.6%，兩者合計接近七成，顯示核心UPS本業需求已逐步正常化。
不過，需求回升並未完全反映在獲利。第2季毛利率僅25.28%，低於2025年同期的28.67%；營益率18.12%，也低於去年同期20.19%。PCB、被動元件及電源管理晶片(PMIC)等材料成本上升，加上人民幣升值，持續侵蝕獲利。
旭隼因此開始調漲UPS價格。公司2026年已進行兩次UPS價格調整，以抵銷原物料成本上升，漲價效益預計自9月開始反映在損益表。第3季隨UPS進入傳統旺季、庫存回補與漲價效益反映，獲利率可望逐步修復。
問題在於，旭隼不是只賣UPS。

中東占逆變器出貨25%至30%，地緣風險直接打到營運
2026年第2季，Inverter占旭隼營收22.8%，這項業務仍受到中東地緣政治、需求疲弱、海運出貨及價格競爭影響。旭隼逆變器市場又以新興國家為主，其中中東約占出貨25%至30%，巴基斯坦、南非及印度也是主要市場，歐美則仍處於布局階段，因此對新興市場景氣與地緣政治變化相對敏感。
相較之下，UPS需求已明顯回溫，且可以透過漲價逐步轉嫁原物料成本；但Inverter一方面受到中東需求與海運出貨干擾，另一方面又面臨激烈價格競爭，成本轉嫁能力明顯弱於UPS，成為今年獲利率的主要拖累之一。
這也造成旭隼第2季出現一個明顯反差：營收比預期高5.6%，毛利率卻比預期差兩個百分點，成為今年獲利拖累因子，代表公司訂單與需求沒問題，問題出在成本轉嫁時程。
逆變器成本上升並非旭隼單一公司的問題。中國逆變器大廠陽光電源Sungrow Power Supply(300274-CN)也因成本不斷上升啟動漲價，自2026年9月20日起調高太陽能逆變器及儲能產品價格5%至15%，反映上游原物料成本上升，顯示成本轉嫁已成為逆變器產業共同課題。
公司未來兩至三季將逐步減少毛利率20%以下的低功率逆變器，轉向高功率及高階產品，未來幾季太陽能逆變器占整體營收比重可能降至20%以下。換句話說，公司並不打算繼續以低價搶逆變器訂單，而是選擇犧牲部分營收，換取後續毛利率改善空間。

逆變器還有另一面，美國供應鏈重組帶來轉單機會
旭隼逆變器今年受到中東市場拖累，但從中長期來看，歐美市場仍存在供應鏈重組機會。今年8月，川普以國家安全為由發布緊急行政命令，限制美國大型電力系統採購、進口、轉讓或安裝特定外國製關鍵電力設備，涵蓋變壓器、逆變器、電池儲能系統、發電渦輪機、變電站電壓調節器、斷路器及控制系統等。美國能源部(DOE)並須在120天內制定正式執行規則，未來不排除建立合格設備與供應商名單。
對旭隼而言，能否利用這波供應鏈重組降低對新興市場的集中度，將成為中長期值得追蹤的另一項變數。
因此，旭隼獲利較明顯的修復時間點仍要等到2027年。隨產品組合逐步轉向客製化UPS，屆時才有辦法出現上修的潛力。根據優分析統計，目前市場預估2027年毛利率可望回升至27.24%，每股盈餘增至41.33元，獲利重新回到成長軌道，也為後續挑戰歷史高點重新累積動能。

2027年之後：HVDC成下一個成長引擎
旭隼另一項值得關注的轉折，來自AI資料中心供電架構改變。隨GPU運算密度快速提升，單一機櫃功耗已從過去數十kW朝100kW以上發展，下一代系統甚至朝1MW等級邁進，傳統以UPS搭配交流配電的供電架構，開始面臨轉換效率、配電容量、線材與機房空間等限制。
HVDC的優勢就在於減少多次AC/DC電力轉換。相較傳統UPS架構，直流供電可降低轉換損耗，同時減少配電設備及線纜需求；當AI資料中心規模放大至數百MW後，即使只有數個百分點的效率差距，也會轉化成可觀的年度電費差異。
而隨電壓進一步提高至800VDC，效益更加明顯。在相同功率下，提高電壓可以降低傳輸電流，因此能減少銅材使用、線路損耗與配電空間。這也是NVIDIA等AI晶片與系統業者開始推動800V HVDC架構的重要原因，目標就是因應未來1MW以上AI機櫃的供電需求。
旭隼過去以傳統UPS為核心，如今800VDC/18.5kW PSU已進入一級客戶送樣階段，400VDC Power Rack則預計2027年下半年開始貢獻；旭隼HVDC已增加至第三家客戶，預計2027年上半年試產、下半年量產。
因此到了2028年將是完整貢獻的年度，屆時旭隼的轉折不只是期待UPS毛利率回升，而是公司產品版圖開始從傳統UPS往AI資料中心HVDC電源延伸。

paras_en: September 15, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center report) – Although the Middle‑East conflict seems far removed from Taiwan's UPS industry, it has already been affecting Xushun (6409‑TW) earnings. The key is that Xushun, besides UPS, also has a sizable inverter business, and inverters are mainly sold to emerging‑market countries. Thus, any geopolitical disruption to local demand or maritime shipping quickly shows up in the company’s operations.

More importantly, UPS demand in 2026 is actually warming up and the company has already passed on higher costs through price hikes, yet analysts still expect full‑year profit to dip to a three‑year low, creating a contrast of “revenue recovery but profit decline.”

UPS demand is back and the company has started raising prices. Xushun posted Q2 2026 revenue of NT$5.554 billion, up 32.1% sequentially, driven mainly by inventory replenishment of on‑line and off‑line UPS units. On‑line UPS accounted for 40.1% of revenue and off‑line UPS 27.6%, together close to 70%, indicating that core UPS demand is gradually normalising.

However, the demand rebound has not fully translated into profit. Q2 gross margin fell to 25.28%, down from 28.67% a year earlier; operating margin slipped to 18.12% from 20.19% in the same period. Rising material costs for PCBs, passive components and power‑management ICs, together with a stronger renminbi, continue to erode earnings.

Xushun therefore began raising UPS prices. The company has implemented two UPS price adjustments in 2026 to offset higher raw‑material costs, with the pricing benefit expected to show in the income statement from September. In Q3, as UPS enters its traditional peak season, inventory replenishment and price‑increase effects should gradually restore profit margins.
The issue is that Xushun does not only sell UPS.

Inverters account for 25%‑30% of Middle‑East shipments, so geopolitical risk hits operations directly. In Q2 2026, inverters made up 22.8% of Xushun’s revenue, a business still affected by Middle‑East geopolitics, weak demand, maritime shipping and price competition. Xushun’s inverter market is focused on emerging economies, with the Middle East representing about 25%‑30% of shipments, and Pakistan, South Africa and India also key markets, while Europe and the U.S. remain in a development stage, making the segment sensitive to emerging‑market cycles and geopolitical shifts.

By contrast, UPS demand has clearly warmed and can pass on raw‑material costs through price hikes; inverter demand, however, is hampered by Middle‑East disruptions and intense price competition, limiting cost‑pass‑through ability and becoming a major drag on this year’s profit margin.

This created a stark contrast in Xushun’s Q2 results: revenue was 5.6% above expectations, yet gross margin lagged by two percentage points, becoming a profit‑dragging factor. It shows that orders and demand are fine, but the timing of cost pass‑through is the problem.

Rising inverter costs are not unique to Xushun. Chinese inverter giant Sungrow Power Supply (300274‑CN) also started raising prices as costs climbed, increasing solar inverter and storage product prices by 5%‑15% effective September 20, 2026, reflecting upstream material cost pressure and indicating that cost pass‑through is an industry‑wide issue.

In the next two to three quarters, the company will gradually phase out low‑power inverters with gross margins below 20%, shifting to higher‑power and higher‑end products. In the coming quarters, solar inverters may fall to less than 20% of total revenue. In other words, Xushun does not intend to keep chasing low‑price inverter orders, opting instead to sacrifice some revenue to improve future margins.

Inverters have another side: U.S. supply‑chain reshoring brings order‑shift opportunities. Xushun’s inverter business suffered this year from the Middle‑East, but in the medium‑to‑long term, Europe and the U.S. still present supply‑chain restructuring chances. In August, former President Trump issued an emergency executive order on national‑security grounds restricting U.S. large‑scale power‑system purchases, imports, transfers or installations of certain foreign‑made critical power equipment, covering transformers, inverters, battery storage systems, turbine generators, substation voltage regulators, circuit breakers and control systems. The U.S. Department of Energy must issue formal rules within 120 days, and a qualified‑equipment and supplier list may be created.
For Xushun, the ability to leverage this supply‑chain reshoring to reduce reliance on emerging‑market sales will be a medium‑to‑long‑term variable worth watching.

Therefore, a noticeable profit recovery for Xushun is not expected until 2027. As the product mix gradually shifts toward custom UPS solutions, upside potential emerges. According to U‑Analysis, the market projects a 2027 gross margin of 27.24% and earnings per share of NT$41.33, returning profit to a growth trajectory and rebuilding momentum to challenge historic highs.

After 2027: HVDC becomes the next growth engine. Another pivotal shift for Xushun comes from changes in AI data‑center power architectures. With GPU compute density soaring, a single rack’s power draw has moved from tens of kW to over 100 kW, and next‑generation systems are heading toward the 1 MW class. Traditional UPS‑plus‑AC distribution architectures now face limits in conversion efficiency, distribution capacity, cabling and floor‑space.

HVDC’s advantage lies in reducing multiple AC‑DC conversions. Compared with conventional UPS setups, DC power delivery cuts conversion losses and reduces the need for distribution equipment and cables; when AI data‑centers scale to several hundred MW, even a few percentage points of efficiency gain translates into substantial annual electricity cost savings.

With voltage further raised to 800 VDC, benefits become even clearer. At the same power level, higher voltage lowers transmission current, reducing copper usage, line losses and distribution space. This is why AI‑chip makers such as NVIDIA and system vendors are promoting 800 V HVDC architectures, aiming to meet the power needs of future AI racks exceeding 1 MW.

Xushun, historically centered on traditional UPS, now has its 800 VDC/18.5 kW PSU in the sample‑delivery stage with a Tier‑1 customer, and its 400 VDC Power Rack is slated to start contributing in the second half of 2027. HVDC has reached a third customer, with pilot production expected in early 2027 and mass production later that year.

Thus, 2028 should be the first full‑year of contribution, marking a transition not only of UPS margin recovery but also of Xushun’s product portfolio expanding from conventional UPS to AI‑data‑center HVDC power solutions.
